title: St. Patrick’s Day
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office celebrates St. Patrick's Day with various activities and interactions. Michael jokes about the holiday, and characters discuss their plans and relationships. Jo prepares to leave the branch, and Darryl proposes a shipping improvement. The episode features office camaraderie, humor, and some conflicts related to work and personal plans.
